findings.title: Length validation happens after the buffer read
findings.description: readFrame copies the declared payload before checking whether the input contains that many bytes.
findings.evidence: A frame with declared length 4096 and a 12 byte body reaches memcpy first, so the read crosses the supplied buffer.
findings.proposed_resolution: Validate the declared length against the remaining input before copying, then add a truncated-frame regression test.

findings.title: The parser name describes one caller instead of the file format
findings.description: ImportJob parses every .trace file, but its public name ties it to the upload screen.
findings.failure_scenario: A second caller must either depend on upload vocabulary or add a duplicate parser wrapper.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename it to TraceFileImporter and update the two call sites.
findings.note: Confirm whether this API is public before choosing the rename scope.

findings.title: The boundary test name promises both limits but checks only the upper limit
findings.description: rejectsOutOfRangeLengths covers a length above the maximum but not a negative decoded length.
findings.evidence: The test body constructs only the oversized case.
findings.proposed_resolution: Rename the test to rejectsOversizedLength or add the missing lower-bound case.
